HSK · Level 6 of 6

HSK 6 vocabulary list
all 2,500 words

HSK 6 adds 2,500 new words, for a cumulative syllabus of about 5,000, the top of the six-level exam. Idioms, register and nuance live here. Every entry shows the hanzi, pinyin with tone marks and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Chinese this list is the HSK 6 pack: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 6 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

02 · Sample sentences

25 words,
each in a sentence

Every word in Lock&Learn Chinese comes with a real example sentence, its reading and a translation, revealed on the tap. Here are 25 from this list.

差距

chājù

disparity or gap

他们两人的学习成绩存在很大差距。

Tāmen liǎng rén de xuéxí chéngjì cúnzài hěn dà chājù.

There is a significant disparity in their academic performance.

传单

chuándān

printed leaflet or flier

他们在街上向行人免费发放传单。

Tāmen zài jiēshàng xiàng xíngrén miǎnfèi fāfàng chuándān.

They are handing out leaflets to pedestrians for free on the street.

和睦

hémù

living in harmony

他们一家人生活得非常和睦。

Tāmen yī jiā rén shēnghuó de fēicháng hémù.

Their family lives in great harmony.

呼吁

hūyù

make an appeal

环保组织呼吁大家减少使用一次性塑料制品。

Huánbǎo zǔzhī hūyù dàjiā jiǎnshǎo shǐyòng yīcìxìng sùliào zhìpǐn.

Environmental groups urge everyone to reduce the use of single-use plastic products.

坚实

jiānshí

solid and substantial

这座桥由于结构非常坚实，可以承受很重的卡车。

Zhè zuò qiáo yóuyú jiégòu fēicháng jiānshí, kěyǐ chéngshòu hěn zhòng de kǎchē.

Because this bridge has a very solid structure, it can withstand very heavy trucks.

纠纷

jiūfēn

dispute, quarrel

他们在买房合同上产生了一些纠纷。

Tāmen zài mǎifáng hétóng shàng chǎnshēngle yīxiē jiūfēn.

They ran into some disputes over the house purchase contract.

唠叨

láodao

nagging or chattering

他总是没完没了地唠叨那些琐事，真让人不耐烦。

Tā zǒngshì méiwán-méiliǎo de láodao nàxiē suǒshì, zhēn ràng rén búnàifán.

He keeps nagging about those trivial things endlessly, which is really annoying.

流氓

liúmáng

a hoodlum or rogue

他整天在大街上游荡，看起来像个流氓。

Tā zhěngtiān zài dàjiē shàng yóudàng, kàn qǐlái xiàng gè liúmáng.

He wanders the streets all day and looks like a hoodlum.

美满

měimǎn

happy and blissful

他们结婚三十年了，一直过着美满的生活。

Tāmen jiéhūn sānshí nián le, yīzhí guòzhe měimǎn de shēnghuó.

They have been married for thirty years and have always lived a happy and blissful life.

凝聚

níngjù

to condense or aggregate

大家的汗水凝聚成一股强大的力量，推动了公司的前行。

Dàjiā de hànshuǐ níngjù chéng yī gǔ qiángdà de lìliàng, tuīdòngle gōngsī de qiánxíng.

Everyone's sweat condensed into a powerful force, driving the company forward.

纽扣儿

niǔkòur

clothing button

这件衣服的纽扣儿掉了一个，我得找个新的缝上去。

Zhè jiàn yīfu de niǔkòur diào le yí gè, wǒ děi zhǎo gè xīn de féng shàngqù.

A button fell off this garment and I need to find a new one to sew on.

浓厚

nónghòu

strong or dense

他对这项研究有着浓厚的兴趣。

Tā duì zhè xiàng yánjiū yǒuzhe nónghòu de xìngqù.

He has a strong interest in this research.

锲而不舍

qiè'érbùshě

persevere without stopping

他为了完成这项科研项目，始终锲而不舍地钻研。

Tā wèile wánchéng zhè xiàng kēyán xiàngmù, shǐzhōng qiè'érbùshě de zuānyán.

To complete this scientific research project, he persevered unremittingly.

闪烁

shǎnshuò

flickering or twinkling

远处的灯光在夜色中闪烁，像夜空里的星星。

Yuǎnchù de dēngguāng zài yèsè zhōng shǎnshuò, xiàng yèkōng lǐ de xīngxing.

Distant lights flickered in the night, looking like stars in the night sky.

岁月

suìyuè

years; time

看着老照片，我不禁感叹岁月如梭。

Kànzhe lǎo zhàopiàn, wǒ bùjīn gǎntàn suìyuè rú suō.

Looking at the old photos, I cannot help but sigh at how time flies.

天文

tiānwén

astronomy

他对天文有着浓厚的兴趣，经常观察星空。

Tā duì tiānwén yǒuzhe nónghòu de xìngqù, jīngcháng guānchá xīngkōng.

He has a keen interest in astronomy and often observes the starry sky.

图案

tú'àn

design or pattern

这块布料上的花朵图案非常别致。

Zhè kuài bùliào shàng de huāduǒ tú'àn fēicháng biézhì.

The floral pattern on this fabric is very unique.

演奏

yǎnzòu

musical performance

她在音乐厅现场演奏了这首经典的钢琴曲。

Tā zài yīnyuètīng xiànchǎng yǎnzòu le zhè shǒu jīngdiǎn de gāngqínqǔ.

She performed this classic piano piece live at the concert hall.

以便

yǐbiàn

so as to

请把相关文件发给我，以便我准备明天的会议。

Qǐng bǎ xiāngguān wénjiàn fā gěi wǒ, yǐbiàn wǒ zhǔnbèi míngtiān de huìyì.

Please send me the relevant documents so that I can prepare for tomorrow's meeting.

预算

yùsuàn

budget

考虑到公司的预算，我们决定缩减这次的公关活动。

Kǎolǜ dào gōngsī de yùsuàn, wǒmen juédìng suōjiǎn zhè cì de gōngguān huódòng.

Considering the company's budget, we decided to scale back this public relations event.

展示

zhǎnshì

to reveal or display

博物馆通过多种方式向观众展示珍贵的历史文物。

Bówùguǎn tōngguò duōzhǒng fāngshì xiàng guānzhòng zhǎnshì zhēnguì de lìshǐ wénwù.

The museum displays precious historical artifacts to visitors in various ways.

正气

zhèngqì

integrity; uprightness

这位老人的言行总是充满正气，大家都很尊敬他。

Zhè wèi lǎorén de yánxíng zǒngshì chōngmǎn zhèngqì, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.

This old man's words and actions are always full of integrity, and everyone respects him very much.

衷心

zhōngxīn

heartfelt and sincere

我衷心希望大家能够在未来的工作中取得好成绩。

Wǒ zhōngxīn xīwàng dàjiā nénggòu zài wèilái de gōngzuò zhōng qǔdé hǎo chéngjì.

I wholeheartedly hope that everyone can achieve good results in their future work.

转达

zhuǎndá

pass on message

请替我向经理转达这份文件的修改意见。

Qǐng tì wǒ xiàng jīnglǐ zhuǎndá zhè fèn wénjiàn de xiūgǎi yìjiàn.

Please help me pass on these revision comments for the document to the manager.

阻拦

zǔlán

stop or block

警察及时阻拦了那名企图闯入银行的男子。

Jǐngchá jíshí zǔlánle nà míng qǐtú chuǎngrù yínháng de nánzǐ.

The police timely intercepted the man who attempted to break into the bank.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the HSK 6 vocabulary list?

2,500. The six-level HSK syllabus adds about 150, 150, 300, 600, 1,300 and 2,500 new words per level, about 5,000 in all; this page lists the words that are new at HSK 6, not the cumulative total.

Is this the official HSK HSK 6 word list?

It follows the official six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0), the list the HSK 1 to 6 exams are still administered on. The HSK 3.0 standard published in 2021 reorganises vocabulary into nine bands and is not what this page shows.

How do I study the HSK 6 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. The HSK 6 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. HSK 6 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the HSK 6 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
